title: Dumaahi waktik nummale xongolo
intro: Qur'aanak addal inki rooci yan, kay xaagi dagoo aayatitteh addat warsan, takkay immay ken meqem kaban keenik qimmoh addah qaddoysaanam. Baxsale maqaaneh Yalli Faatiteh, Ta Dumaahih Ayfaafay Kaxxa Racmatta arac yabbixe wahyi galitte. Ku taama ta assakat le muuci baxisaanama. oson miyya kinnoonum atu fayramissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu Yallih farmoyta kinniyo woo seehadayti baxih dumaahi horaarih fanat suge.
Yalli isi kitaabal yoo galab kak xageh gersi farmoytit luk, inkih inki meqe maqaaneh faatiteenih.
Anu qhur'aanal numma num kinniyom baxxaqimeh an.
Yalli yoo fayya hee fayyale caddoy dago mari edde gufe.
Yi migaq Suurat Al-Anbiyal galab kak xaggiime, gersi namma nabiyyih sabrih faatit luk buttaati.
Anu idris kinniyo, numma leeh fayyale nabiyyi.

identity.label: Anu miyyaay?
options: Nabi Idris
Nuuc farmoyti
Nabi ibraahim
Nabi Muusa
Nabi Ismaaqil

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Sabri kee numma dacrisaanam, tokkeek fayyale guddaaqa fan fayya haanama
kaxxa doonik xisaanam diini mara finqa weeqi catnuh
Girah addat qidaanam kee inki gabuuk biyaakite kal yawqeenimi
caylale amoytat garayaanam kee kay qande baab abeynit yayseenimi
Baddi addat yan kaxxa kullumti garbak addat waaraanama
trial.answer: Sabri kee numma dacrisaanam, tokkeek fayyale guddaaqa fan fayya haanama

location.label: Lafa le liyyitte
options: Yallih gabat fayya leeh fayya le guddaaqa
kaxxa markab luucwak xissiimem kee tar luk xakbimte
uma amoyti asnaamah yacbudenit laqissah tan gira
kafin gititte fan kurruuma fidin bad
Gayyak gubal tan kaxxa kullumti data garba
location.answer: Yallih gabat fayya leeh fayya le guddaaqa

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Yallih racmatat oggoleh meqe marak numuk teyna akkuk.
Baadal tan weeqi inkih tan diini mara lih cattiimeh
Gira xage kal girak yewqeh
Israa'iil xaylo salaamah badak amobaxxaaqa fan miraacisen
Mango liggiditteh gibdaabinak lakal kicnon buxah marat qagitaak yengelen
outcome.answer: Yallih racmatat oggoleh meqe marak numuk teyna akkuk.

arabic: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient. (21:85)
